fusions.name: Kneading Claws
fusions.desc: A claw strike that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds. You move 10% faster for 2 seconds after each one.

fusions.name: Soundless Roll
fusions.desc: You roll up to 6 tiles to the target and strike it, dealing 28 damage, rising to 1.5 times that from the full 6 tiles. The hit is always a critical hit.

fusions.name: Righting Tumble
fusions.desc: You roll 3 tiles forward and move 20% faster for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Feet First
fusions.desc: Once every 300 seconds, a blow that would kill you leaves you at 1 health instead.
